whatIsMeridian.title: ℹ️ What is Meridian
whatIsMeridian.body:
*Meridian* is a digital capital management ecosystem.

At its core is a central *Treasury* that operates across multiple digital asset markets:
• Exchange arbitrage
• P2P operations
• Cross-platform and cross-market opportunities
• AI-assisted trading and market analysis
• Automated risk management

Participants don't trade themselves — they deposit and allocate capital into staking products. Meridian calculates the Treasury's actual performance, and the result is distributed proportionally across active staking positions.

The long-term goal is to grow this infrastructure into a broader decentralized ecosystem with its own DAO token, user levels, rewards and governance.

howItWorks.title: ⚙️ How it works
howItWorks.body:
The Meridian ecosystem has three layers:

*1. Meridian Treasury*
Provides the operational capital used across all strategies.

*2. Meridian Infrastructure*
Capital is distributed across exchanges, wallets, P2P markets and other supported platforms where strategies are executed.

*3. Meridian Participants*
Users deposit assets and allocate their balance into available staking products.

At the end of each reporting period, Meridian calculates the actual result generated by its active strategies and allocates it proportionally among staking positions, according to their terms.

📌 *Example:* if the Treasury reports a +0.30% daily result, all active staking positions participate proportionally to their capital, minus the applicable Meridian fee.

Meridian does not use a fixed-interest model — performance is always based on actual Treasury activity.

treasury.title: 🏦 Treasury & strategies
treasury.body:
At the initial stage, the Treasury operates with approximately *$200,000* of working capital. The initial participant-capital capacity is also about $200,000 — this is intentional, so the infrastructure doesn't take on more than it can support. Limits will increase as Meridian scales.

*Revenue strategies:*

🔁 *Exchange arbitrage* — buying/selling assets across exchanges when a viable price difference exists.

🤝 *P2P operations* — working in peer-to-peer markets where local demand, liquidity and exchange rate differences create opportunities.

🌍 *Cross-market operations* — operating across different countries, exchanges and digital asset markets simultaneously.

🤖 *AI trading* — a controlled component of the strategy. Under the current risk model, up to *10%* of eligible Treasury capital may be allocated to AI-assisted trading, depending on market conditions.

Arbitrage and other lower-directional-risk activities are prioritized before allocating capital to higher-risk trading.

*Role of AI:* market analysis, opportunity detection, exchange comparison, risk analysis, position monitoring, strategy optimization, data processing, anomaly detection. AI does not remove financial risk — it helps the team make decisions more efficiently.

staking.title: 📈 Staking & fees
staking.body:
Participants allocate their available balance into one of the staking products. Four categories are available at launch:

💧 *Flexible Staking* — no fixed period. Meridian fee: *20%* of generated profit.

📅 *1-Day Staking* — capital locked for 1 day. Fee: *10%*.

📆 *1-Week Staking* — capital locked for 1 week. Fee: *5%*.

🗓️ *1-Month Staking* — capital locked for 1 month. Fee: *3%*.

⚠️ These percentages are *Meridian's share of generated profit* — not an interest rate and not a promised return.

📌 *Example:* if a position generates $10 in profit with a 10% fee, Meridian receives $1 and the participant is credited $9.

Staking limits may depend on account level, available balance and other ecosystem conditions.

deposits.title: 💰 Deposits & withdrawals
deposits.body:
*Deposits*
At launch, Meridian supports: *USDT — TRC20 network*. Additional networks and payment methods will be added as the ecosystem develops.

⚠️ Your deposit address is always issued inside the official Meridian App — this bot never publishes or requests wallet addresses.

Under the initial model, a participant who deposits 100 USDT is expected to allocate approximately that amount through eligible staking products before the original deposit becomes freely withdrawable. This keeps deposits aligned with actual participation.

*Withdrawals*
After a staking position completes its required period, the corresponding balance becomes eligible for withdrawal under Meridian's applicable rules.

Withdrawal conditions, supported networks and processing limits may evolve as the infrastructure expands.

bonuses.title: 🎁 Bonuses & rewards
bonuses.body:
Bonuses are an important part of the Meridian experience.

*Main bonus categories:*
• 🎉 Registration bonus
• ✅ Verification bonus
• 💵 First deposit bonus
• 🤝 Referral bonus
• 📈 Staking bonuses (daily / weekly / monthly)

Bonus balances may have different conditions than deposited funds — for example, some bonuses may only be eligible for longer-term staking products.

🎡 *Daily Wheel*
One of Meridian's core engagement mechanisms. Eligible users can spin the wheel once per day for different rewards and bonuses. Available rewards and probabilities may evolve as Meridian grows.

🤝 *Referral system*
Meridian initially operates on a referral-based model — new participants need an invitation to join. Rewards are available for eligible referrals and referral activity, connected to the Points and Levels system.

levels.title: 🏆 Points & levels
levels.body:
*Meridian Points*
Points measure participation in the ecosystem. Earned through:
• Staking
• Account activity
• Referrals
• Verification
• Deposits
• Ecosystem participation
• Selected tasks and campaigns

Points build the user's *Level*.

*Level progression:*
🥉 Bronze → 🥈 Silver → 🥇 Gold → 💎 Platinum → ⚫ Obsidian

Higher levels can unlock:
• Increased staking limits
• Additional bonuses
• Improved reward opportunities
• Exclusive drops
• Access to selected products
• Future token-related benefits

Exact requirements and benefits per level may evolve as Meridian collects operational data.

token.title: 🪙 Token & DAO
token.body:
*Fund Unit*
An internal accounting unit representing participation in Meridian. It is *not a blockchain token* — at this stage it's part of Meridian's internal financial accounting infrastructure.

*Meridian DAO Token (planned)*
A separate blockchain-based ecosystem token is planned for a future phase. It may become an access and governance layer, potentially offering:
• DAO governance
• Access to selected staking products
• Ecosystem access
• Level benefits
• Reward programs and drops
• Voting on selected decisions

⚠️ Token architecture, blockchain, supply and tokenomics are *not yet finalized* — details will be published separately before launch. Nothing here should be read as a promise of future token value.

*Meridian DAO*
The long-term vision includes progressively introducing decentralized governance in selected areas. Treasury management and security-sensitive decisions are likely to remain under professional management rather than open public voting.

roadmap.title: 🗺️ Roadmap
roadmap.body:
*Phase 1 — Infrastructure*
Initial Treasury and operating model, Meridian App, website and Telegram infrastructure, initial Treasury capitalization.

*Phase 2 — Launch*
Ecosystem launch, Meridian Bot activation, referral-based onboarding, initial staking products, Daily Wheel, Points & Levels, initial bonus ecosystem.

*Phase 3 — Expansion*
Treasury growth, expanded participant capacity, additional deposit methods and blockchain networks, expanded staking products, more bonuses, improved transparency, expanded AI infrastructure.

*Phase 4 — Meridian Web3*
DAO architecture, tokenomics publication, Meridian DAO Token development, token utility integration, drops and token-based levels.

*Phase 5 — Meridian Ecosystem*
International expansion, additional fintech products, expanded AI systems, new capital-management products, DAO development, additional blockchain integrations.

security.title: 🔒 Security
security.body:
Meridian does not rely on a single wallet or platform for all operational activity.

Treasury infrastructure may be distributed across:
• Centralized exchanges (CEX)
• Decentralized exchanges (DEX)
• Corporate wallets
• Operational wallets
• P2P platforms
• Other approved infrastructure

Critical wallet infrastructure can use multisignature authorization and restricted access. Only authorized members of the operating structure can access relevant Treasury infrastructure.

Exact wallet addresses, platform allocations and security architecture may remain private when disclosure could create additional risk.

risks.title: ⚠️ Risks
risks.body:
Participation in Meridian involves risk. *Meridian does not guarantee a fixed return.* Past performance does not guarantee future results.

*Key risk categories:*
• Digital asset market risk
• Exchange risk
• Counterparty risk
• P2P counterparty risk
• Stablecoin risk
• Liquidity risk
• Blockchain and network risk
• Smart contract risk
• Wallet and custody risk
• Cybersecurity risk
• AI and algorithmic risk
• Operational risk
• Regulatory and legal risk

📌 Only participate with capital you can afford to expose to financial risk.

_This bot provides information for informational purposes only. It does not constitute financial, investment, legal or tax advice, an offer of securities, or a guarantee of profit._
